game.title: Assassin's Creed Syndicate
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure set in Victorian London, played as the twins Jacob and Evie, from Ubisoft Quebec (RAWG also lists Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Singapore), released 2015-10-23. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Nine Memory Sequences as Jacob and Evie take London back, and full sync in the main memories. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Boroughs, Gangs and Side Activities
chapters.summary: Gang strongholds, fight clubs, street races, raids, bounties, Templar hunts, child liberation, cargo escorts, crowd events, associates and the World War I simulation.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Viewpoints
chapters.summary: Pressed flowers, historical posters, royal letters, the Secrets of London, beer brands and every viewpoint.

chapters.title: Combat, Skills, Gear and Vehicles
chapters.summary: Skills for Jacob and Evie, perks, gang upgrades, crafting, carriages, trains and combat feats.

chapters.title: Jack the Ripper (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Jack the Ripper expansion: fear tactics, Brutal Takedowns, its skills and full sync.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Assassin's Creed: Syndicate" (the unpunctuated title redirects there), at completion stage 0 and marked a stub; only a Table of Contents subpage exists, and Controls, Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. assassinscreed.fandom.com has no page under "Assassin's Creed Syndicate" but answers under "Assassin's Creed: Syndicate", with about 475 linked pages, including "Jack the Ripper (DLC)", "The Last Maharaja" and "The Dreadful Crimes"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The DLC name "Jack the Ripper" also appears in RAWG's search results and in the "Ripperologist" achievement. None of the 56 Steam achievements is hidden. The seven achievements listed last ("A well-kept secret" to "Ripperologist") were placed in the Jack the Ripper chapter by schema position and by their descriptions (Whitechapel, fear, Brutal Takedowns, "100% synchronization in Jack the Ripper"). "The War at Home" (the World War I simulation) was put with side activities. The Steam descriptions use non-breaking spaces, so the sorting rules match any space.
